section_1.title: Settled status and Student Finance
section_1.description: Understand how settled status, pre-settled status and residency history may affect funding routes.

section_2.title: What students usually need to know.
section_2.description: Clear, useful guidance designed for mature students who want a realistic route into university.

cards.title: Status matters
cards.description: British citizenship, settled status, ILR and refugee status are common eligible categories.

cards.title: Evidence is important
cards.description: Students may need a share code, ID and proof of UK residence.

cards.title: Residency history
cards.description: SFE often checks where you lived before the course starts.

cards.title: Pre-settled can be complex
cards.description: Some students qualify, others need specialist checking depending on work and residence.

cards.title: Funding type varies
cards.description: Tuition, maintenance and grants may depend on category and circumstances.

cards.title: Check before applying
cards.description: Eligibility mistakes can delay or damage an application.

section_3.title: Turn this guide into a plan.
section_3.description: We can help you compare routes, understand funding and prepare your application documents.
section_3.ctaDescription: Start with eligibility, then speak to an adviser if you want human support.
